name: appifex-monorepo
description: Composable toolkit for UI/UX-driven mobile app development

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @appifex/core run build && pnpm --filter @appifex/runner run build && pnpm --filter '!@appifex/core' --filter '!@appifex/runner' --filter '!@appifex/cli' --filter '!@appifex/mcp-server' -r run build && pnpm --filter @appifex/cli run build && pnpm --filter @appifex/mcp-server run build
